title: DBPSK Demodulator Baseband
text: 解调 DBPSK 调制数据，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output data type} 指定输出数据类型 Inherit via；{Phase rotation (rad)} 指定附加相移、{Decision type} 指定解调的判决方法 Hard、{Noise variance source} 指定噪声方差源、{Noise variance} 指定噪声的方差，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: DBPSK 调制的基带信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: 噪声方差 positive scalar | vector of positive values

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 scalar | column vector

params.name: Decision type
params.values: 解调的判决方法 Hard decision (default) | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: 噪声方差源 Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean
